# CertQuests — llms.txt

> Free practice tests, courses, and gamified learning paths for IT
> certifications: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, CompTIA, Kubernetes,
> Docker, Terraform, and more. No signup required.

## What we offer

- **Practice tests** at `/certifications/` — pack pickers per cert
  vendor, with two play modes per pack: quick quiz and a gamified
  learning path.
- **Free courses** at `/courses/` — 22 deeply-expanded courses with
  module intros, key takeaways, and linked mini-quizzes (Linux+,
  Docker DCA, GCP ACE / PCA / PDE, AWS sextet, Kubernetes CKA / CKAD
  / CKS, CompTIA Security+, Terraform Associate, and more).
- **Learning paths** at `/path.html` — Duolingo-style maps: concept
  cards → mini-quizzes → sub-bosses → final exam, with hearts,
  cosmetics, and XP.
- **Cheatsheets** at `/cheatsheets/` — single-page recap of exam
  domains per cert.

## Career + decision content

- `/careers/` — guides like "Is the AWS SAA-C03 worth it in 2026?",
  interview questions, sysadmin-to-SRE roadmaps.
- `/compare/` — head-to-head comparators (CKA vs CKAD,
  AZ-104 vs AWS SAA-C03, CompTIA Security+ vs CISSP, etc.).
- `/salaire/` — salary data by certification and country (FR-first).
- `/career-path/` — multi-step paths to common cloud roles.
- `/reality-check/` — honest "what does this cert actually unlock?"
  scope notes.

## Tools

- `/study-planner/` — generate a per-cert study plan from your
  target date and available hours/week.
- `/infracost/` — live AWS price comparator (client-side fetch).
- `/salary-predictor/` — estimate salary after an IT cert by country +
  experience: pay range, 5-year trajectory, cert ROI/payback, market
  demand (indicative, client-side over curated salary data).
- `/tech-war-map/` — interactive regional heatmap of cloud dominance
  (AWS/Azure/Google/local), salaries, demand and AI growth by world
  region (indicative curated data).
- `/cloud-explorer/` — interactive animated AWS architecture (VPC, ALB,
  Auto Scaling, RDS multi-AZ) with normal/attack/scaling/failure
  scenarios; each service deep-links into the question bank.
- `/roadmap/` — your saved Personal Roadmap: pick a career role, get the
  recommended cert sequence (from data/career-paths), reorder it, and
  track real progress (localStorage cq-roadmap-v1; seeded by /career-quiz/
  and /career-path/, summarised on /profile.html).
- `/leaderboard/` — weekly XP leaderboard for signed-in users.
- `/devstack/`, `/prompt-dungeon/`, `/tool-radar/`, `/failbase/`,
  `/fail-analysis/` — engineering-as-marketing tools.

## Accounts

Anonymous play is the default. Optional Supabase-backed sign-in
(email/password, magic link, Google OAuth) syncs progress across
devices. See `/profile.html` after signing in.

## Tech

Static HTML/CSS/vanilla-JS on Cloudflare Pages. Supabase for auth +
per-user data (RLS-enforced). PWA-installable with a service worker
for offline access to question banks and learning paths.

## Canonical surfaces (high-value for citation)

- `/` — site root
- `/certifications/` — cert directory
- `/courses/` — course directory
- `/learning/<pack>/` — per-cert long-form course (22 packs deeply
  expanded as of 2026-05-18)
- `/cheatsheets/` — per-cert cheatsheets
- `/careers/` — career articles
- `/compare/` — comparator pages
- `/salaire/<cert>/<country>/` — salary by cert × country
- `/path.html?pack=<id>` — gamified learning path per cert

## Out of scope

- The CertQuests Android app lives in a separate repository. This
  site is the web product.

Last reviewed: 2026-05-18
